questions.text: What are the challenges of democracy?
questions.text_as_printed: What are the challenges of democracy? (Average)

answer.value:
The challenges of democracy are:
Money and muscle power can be used to garner votes.
Caste, religion, and language have an influence in elections.
Elected representatives change parties for their self-interest.
In this system, there is a chance for goons and criminals to be elected.

questions.text: Explain the differences between monarchy and democracy.
questions.text_as_printed: Explain the differences between monarchy and democracy. (Average)

answer.value:
The differences between monarchy and democracy are:
Monarchy:
Here all government powers lie in the hands of one individual.
The king acts according to his wishes.
There are no restrictions on the king's term of rule.
A state flourishes under a brave and wise king.
Democracy:
Here all government powers are in the hands of elected representatives.
The elected representatives act according to the wishes of the people.
There is a limit to the term of elected representatives.
The government becomes strong through the good work of the representatives.

questions.text: Explain the stages of the election process.
questions.text_as_printed: Explain the stages of the election process. (Difficult)

answer.value:
The stages of the electoral process are:
Elections will be conducted like a schedule;
Issuing the election notification
Submission of nomination papers by candidates at the beginning
Verification of nomination papers
Withdrawal of nomination papers by candidates wishing to withdraw from the competition
Election campaigning by candidates and party leaders for votes
Voting on the designated date
Counting of votes and announcement of results
Release of the list of winning candidates
